verses.original: Πέτρος δὲ καὶ Ἰωάννης ἀνέβαινον εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἐπὶ τὴν ὥραν τῆς προσευχῆς τὴν ἐνάτην
verses.transliteration: Petros de kai Iōannēs anebainon eis to hieron epi tēn hōran tēs proseuchēs tēn enatēn
verses.literal: One afternoon Peter and John were going up to the temple at the hour of prayer the ninth hour
verses.literalPt: Pedro e João subiam ao templo para a oração da hora nona.

verses.original: καί τις ἀνὴρ χωλὸς ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς αὐτοῦ ὑπάρχων ἐβαστάζετο ὃν ἐτίθουν καθ’ ἡμέραν πρὸς τὴν θύραν τοῦ ἱεροῦ τὴν λεγομένην Ὡραίαν τοῦ αἰτεῖν ἐλεημοσύνην παρὰ τῶν εἰσπορευομένων εἰς τὸ ἱερόν
verses.transliteration: kai tis anēr chōlos ek koilias mētros autou hyparchōn ebastazeto hon etithoun kath’ hēmeran pros tēn thyran tou hierou tēn legomenēn Hōraian tou aitein eleēmosynēn para tōn eisporeuomenōn eis to hieron
verses.literal: And a man who was lame from birth was being carried to the temple gate called Beautiful where he was put every day to beg . . . from those entering . . . the temple courts
verses.literalPt: Era levado um homem, coxo de nascença, o qual punham cada dia à porta do templo, chamada Formosa, para pedir esmola aos que entravam.

verses.original: ὃς ἰδὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην μέλλοντας εἰσιέναι εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν ἠρώτα ἐλεημοσύνην λαβεῖν
verses.transliteration: hos idōn Petron kai Iōannēn mellontas eisienai eis to hieron ērōta eleēmosynēn labein
verses.literal: When he saw Peter and John about to enter - he asked them for money
verses.literalPt: Este, vendo a Pedro e a João, que iam entrar no templo, implorava-lhes que lhe dessem uma esmola.

verses.original: Ἀτενίσας δὲ Πέτρος εἰς αὐτὸν σὺν τῷ Ἰωάννῃ εἶπεν Βλέψον εἰς ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Atenisas de Petros eis auton syn tō Iōannē eipen Blepson eis hēmas
verses.literal: Peter looked directly at him as did John Look at us said Peter
verses.literalPt: Pedro, fitando os olhos nele, juntamente com João, disse: Olha para nós.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἐπεῖχεν αὐτοῖς προσδοκῶν τι παρ’ αὐτῶν λαβεῖν
verses.transliteration: ho de epeichen autois prosdokōn ti par’ autōn labein
verses.literal: So the man gave them his attention . . . expecting to receive something from them
verses.literalPt: Ele, esperando receber deles alguma coisa, olhava-os com atenção.

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ Πέτρος Ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον οὐχ ὑπάρχει μοι ὃ δὲ ἔχω τοῦτό σοι δίδωμι ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Ναζωραίου ἔγειρε καὶ περιπάτει
verses.transliteration: eipen de Petros Argyrion kai chrysion ouch hyparchei moi ho de echō touto soi didōmi en tō onomati Iēsou Christou tou Nazōraiou egeire kai peripatei
verses.literal: But Peter said Silver or gold I do not have . . . . . . but what I have I give you In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth get up and walk
verses.literalPt: Mas Pedro disse: Não tenho prata nem ouro, mas o que tenho, isso te dou; em nome de Jesus Cristo, o Nazareno, anda.

verses.original: Καὶ πιάσας αὐτὸν τῆς δεξιᾶς χειρὸς ἤγειρεν αὐτόν παραχρῆμα δὲ ἐστερεώθησαν αἱ βάσεις αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ σφυδρά
verses.transliteration: Kai piasas auton tēs dexias cheiros ēgeiren auton parachrēma de estereōthēsan hai baseis autou kai ta sphydra
verses.literal: Taking him by the right hand Peter helped him up . . . and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong
verses.literalPt: Tomando-o pela mão direita, o levantou; logo os seus pés e artelhos se firmaram,

verses.original: καὶ ἐξαλλόμενος ἔστη καὶ περιεπάτει καὶ εἰσῆλθεν σὺν αὐτοῖς εἰς τὸ ἱερὸν περιπατῶν καὶ ἁλλόμενος καὶ αἰνῶν τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: kai exallomenos estē kai periepatei kai eisēlthen syn autois eis to hieron peripatōn kai hallomenos kai ainōn ton Theon
verses.literal: He sprang to his feet and began to walk Then he went with them into the temple courts walking and leaping and praising God
verses.literalPt: e, dando um salto, pôs-se em pé e começou a andar; e entrou com eles no templo, andando, saltando e louvando a Deus.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτὸν περιπατοῦντα καὶ αἰνοῦντα τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Kai eiden pas ho laos auton peripatounta kai ainounta ton Theon
verses.literal: When all the people saw him walking and praising God
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo, vendo-o andar e louvar a Deus

verses.original: ἐπεγίνωσκον δὲ αὐτὸν ὅτι οὗτος ἦν ὁ πρὸς τὴν ἐλεημοσύνην καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῇ Ὡραίᾳ Πύλῃ τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ ἐπλήσθησαν θάμβους καὶ ἐκστάσεως ἐπὶ τῷ συμβεβηκότι αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: epeginōskon de auton hoti houtos ēn ho pros tēn eleēmosynēn kathēmenos epi tē Hōraia Pylē tou hierou kai eplēsthēsan thambous kai ekstaseōs epi tō symbebēkoti autō
verses.literal: they recognized him as - the man who used to sit begging at the Beautiful Gate of the temple and they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him
verses.literalPt: e reconhecendo ser este o homem que se assentava a esmolar à Porta Formosa do templo, ficaram cheios de admiração e pasmo pelo que lhe acontecera.

verses.original: Κρατοῦντος δὲ αὐτοῦ τὸν Πέτρον καὶ τὸν Ἰωάννην συνέδραμεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῇ στοᾷ τῇ καλουμένῃ Σολομῶντος ἔκθαμβοι
verses.transliteration: Kratountos de autou ton Petron kai ton Iōannēn synedramen pas ho laos pros autous epi tē stoa tē kaloumenē Solomōntos ekthamboi
verses.literal: While the man clung to Peter and John all the people were astonished and ran to them in the walkway called Solomon’s Colonnade
verses.literalPt: Segurando-se ele a Pedro e a João, todo o povo, atônito, acorreu para eles no pórtico chamado de Salomão.

verses.original: ἰδὼν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος ἀπεκρίνατο πρὸς τὸν λαόν Ἄνδρες Ἰσραηλῖται τί θαυμάζετε ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἢ ἡμῖν τί ἀτενίζετε ὡς ἰδίᾳ δυνάμει ἢ εὐσεβείᾳ πεποιηκόσιν τοῦ περιπατεῖν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: idōn de ho Petros apekrinato pros ton laon Andres Israēlitai ti thaumazete epi toutō ē hēmin ti atenizete hōs idia dynamei ē eusebeia pepoiēkosin tou peripatein auton
verses.literal: And when Peter saw this he addressed the people Men of Israel why are you surprised by this Why do you stare at us as if by our own power or godliness we had made this man walk
verses.literalPt: Pedro, vendo isso, disse ao povo: Israelitas, por que vos maravilhais deste homem ou por que fitais os olhos em nós, como se por nosso poder ou piedade o tivéssemos feito andar?

verses.original: Ὁ Θεὸς Ἀβραὰμ καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ἰσαὰκ καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ἰακώβ ὁ Θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐδόξασεν τὸν Παῖδα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν ὃν ὑμεῖς μὲν παρεδώκατε καὶ ἠρνήσασθε κατὰ πρόσωπον Πιλάτου κρίναντος ἐκείνου ἀπολύειν
verses.transliteration: Ho Theos Abraam kai ho theos Isaak kai ho theos Iakōb ho Theos tōn paterōn hēmōn edoxasen ton Paida autou Iēsoun hon hymeis men paredōkate kai ērnēsasthe kata prosōpon Pilatou krinantos ekeinou apolyein
verses.literal: The God of Abraham - Isaac and - Jacob the God of our fathers has glorified His servant Jesus You handed Him over and rejected Him before Pilate even though he had decided to release Him
verses.literalPt: O Deus de Abraão, de Isaque e de Jacó, o Deus de nossos pais, glorificou a seu Servo Jesus, a quem vós entregastes e negastes perante Pilatos, quando este havia resolvido soltá-lo;

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ τὸν Ἅγιον καὶ Δίκαιον ἠρνήσασθε καὶ ᾐτήσασθε ἄνδρα φονέα χαρισθῆναι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hymeis de ton Hagion kai Dikaion ērnēsasthe kai ētēsasthe andra phonea charisthēnai hymin
verses.literal: You rejected the Holy and Righteous One and asked that a murderer be released to you
verses.literalPt: mas vós negastes o Santo e Justo, e pedistes que se vos desse um homicida,

verses.original: τὸν δὲ Ἀρχηγὸν τῆς ζωῆς ἀπεκτείνατε ὃν ὁ Θεὸς ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν οὗ ἡμεῖς μάρτυρές ἐσμεν
verses.transliteration: ton de Archēgon tēs zōēs apekteinate hon ho Theos ēgeiren ek nekrōn hou hēmeis martyres esmen
verses.literal: You killed the Author of life but God raised Him from the dead and we are witnesses of this fact
verses.literalPt: e matastes o Autor da vida, a quem Deus ressuscitou dentre os mortos, do que nós somos testemunhas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ πίστει τοῦ ὀνόματος αὐτοῦ τοῦτον ὃν θεωρεῖτε καὶ οἴδατε ἐστερέωσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ πίστις ἡ δι’ αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν ὁλοκληρίαν ταύτην ἀπέναντι πάντων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai epi tē pistei tou onomatos autou touton hon theōreite kai oidate estereōsen to onoma autou kai hē pistis hē di’ autou edōken autō tēn holoklērian tautēn apenanti pantōn hymōn
verses.literal: By faith in the name of Jesus this man whom you see and know has been made strong It is Jesus’ name and the faith that comes through Him that has given him this complete healing in your presence . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Pela fé em seu nome, fortaleceu o seu nome a este homem, a quem vedes e conheceis; sim, a fé, que vem por meio de Jesus, deu a este saúde perfeita na presença de todos vós.

verses.original: Καὶ νῦν ἀδελφοί οἶδα ὅτι κατὰ ἄγνοιαν ἐπράξατε ὥσπερ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai nyn adelphoi oida hoti kata agnoian epraxate hōsper kai hoi archontes hymōn
verses.literal: And now brothers I know that you acted in ignorance as did your leaders
verses.literalPt: Agora, irmãos, eu sei que o fizestes por ignorância, como também as vossas autoridades;

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Θεὸς ἃ προκατήγγειλεν διὰ στόματος πάντων τῶν προφητῶν παθεῖν τὸν Χριστὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπλήρωσεν οὕτως
verses.transliteration: ho de Theos ha prokatēngeilen dia stomatos pantōn tōn prophētōn pathein ton Christon autou eplērōsen houtōs
verses.literal: But in this way God has fulfilled what He foretold through all the prophets saying that His Christ would suffer
verses.literalPt: mas Deus assim cumpriu o que já dantes anunciara, por boca de todos os profetas, que o seu Cristo havia de padecer.

verses.original: μετανοήσατε οὖν καὶ ἐπιστρέψατε πρὸς τὸ ἐξαλειφθῆναι ὑμῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: metanoēsate oun kai epistrepsate pros to exaleiphthēnai hymōn tas hamartias
verses.literal: Repent then and turn back so that your sins may be wiped away
verses.literalPt: Arrependei-vos, pois, e convertei-vos, para serem apagados os vossos pecados, de sorte que da presença do Senhor venham tempos de refrigério

verses.original: ὅπως ἂν ἔλθωσιν καιροὶ ἀναψύξεως ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ ἀποστείλῃ τὸν προκεχειρισμένον ὑμῖν Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: hopōs an elthōsin kairoi anapsyxeōs apo prosōpou tou Kyriou kai aposteilē ton prokecheirismenon hymin Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: that . . . times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord and that He may send Jesus the Christ who has been appointed for you
verses.literalPt: e que envie aquele que já vos foi indicado, Jesus, o Cristo,

verses.original: ὃν δεῖ οὐρανὸν μὲν δέξασθαι ἄχρι χρόνων ἀποκαταστάσεως πάντων ὧν ἐλάλησεν ὁ Θεὸς διὰ στόματος τῶν ἁγίων ἀπ’ αἰῶνος αὐτοῦ προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: hon dei ouranon men dexasthai achri chronōn apokatastaseōs pantōn hōn elalēsen ho Theos dia stomatos tōn hagiōn ap’ aiōnos autou prophētōn
verses.literal: Heaven must take Him in . . . until the time comes for the restoration of all things which God announced long ago through . . . . . . His holy prophets
verses.literalPt: ao qual é necessário que o céu receba até os tempos da restauração de todas as coisas, de que Deus falou por boca dos seus santos profetas de outrora.

verses.original: Μωϋσῆς μὲν εἶπεν ὅτι Προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὑμῶν ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Mōusēs men eipen hoti Prophētēn hymin anastēsei Kyrios ho Theos hymōn ek tōn adelphōn hymōn hōs eme autou akousesthe kata panta hosa an lalēsē pros hymas
verses.literal: For Moses said The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers You must listen to Him in everything . . . . . . He tells . . . you
verses.literalPt: Moisés, na verdade, disse: O Senhor Deus vos suscitará dentre vossos irmãos um profeta semelhante a mim; a ele ouvireis em tudo quanto vos disser.

verses.original: ἔσται δὲ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἥτις ἐὰν μὴ ἀκούσῃ τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: estai de pasa psychē hētis ean mē akousē tou prophētou ekeinou exolethreuthēsetai ek tou laou
verses.literal: Everyone . . . who does not listen to Him will be completely cut off from among his people
verses.literalPt: Acontecerá que toda alma que não ouvir a esse profeta será exterminada do meio do povo.

verses.original: Καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ προφῆται ἀπὸ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν καθεξῆς ὅσοι ἐλάλησαν καὶ κατήγγειλαν τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας
verses.transliteration: Kai pantes de hoi prophētai apo Samouēl kai tōn kathexēs hosoi elalēsan kai katēngeilan tas hēmeras tautas
verses.literal: Indeed all the prophets from Samuel on as many as have spoken have proclaimed these days
verses.literalPt: Igualmente, todos os profetas desde Samuel e os que sucederam, quantos falaram, anunciaram também estes dias.

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῆς διαθήκης ἧς ὁ Θεὸς διέθετο πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν λέγων πρὸς Ἀβραάμ Καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου ἐνευλογηθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: hymeis este hoi huioi tōn prophētōn kai tēs diathēkēs hēs ho Theos dietheto pros tous pateras hymōn legōn pros Abraam Kai en tō spermati sou eneulogēthēsontai pasai hai patriai tēs gēs
verses.literal: And you are sons of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your fathers when He said to Abraham Through your offspring all the families of the earth will be blessed
verses.literalPt: Vós sois os filhos dos profetas e da aliança que Deus estabeleceu com vossos pais, dizendo a Abraão: Na tua descendência, serão abençoadas todas as famílias da terra.

verses.original: ὑμῖν πρῶτον ἀναστήσας ὁ Θεὸς τὸν Παῖδα αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εὐλογοῦντα ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέφειν ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῶν πονηριῶν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hymin prōton anastēsas ho Theos ton Paida autou apesteilen auton eulogounta hymas en tō apostrephein hekaston apo tōn ponēriōn hymōn
verses.literal: When God raised up His Servant He sent Him first to you to bless you by turning each of you from your wicked ways
verses.literalPt: Deus suscitou ao seu Servo e a vós primeiramente vo-lo enviou para vos abençoar, apartando a cada um de vós das suas iniquidades.
